newsitem.title: CHINA: China 1997 land under grain up, cotton down.
newsitem.headline: China 1997 land under grain up, cotton down.

text.p: China's land under grain is expected to rise in 1997, but acreage under cotton is seen shrinking, State Statistical Bureau spokesman Ye Zhen said on Friday.
Land under grain was expected to increase by 400,000 hectares (988,000 acres) this year to 110 million hectares (271.8 million acres), Ye told a news conference.
Acreage under cotton was forecast to fall this year due to flagging demand, Ye said. He declined to give a figure.
The official media has estimated 1997 acreage under cotton at 4.56 million hectares (11.3 million acres) -- the lowest level in 10 years -- down by 4.2 percent from last year.
Total farm land was expected to climb 1.05 percent to 153 million hectares (378 million acres) in 1997, Ye said. He gave no further details.
